Re-registration for the next semester
Guest students
Guest students may
re-register for a subsequent semester
only if you have been admitted to this or were allowed to extend your studies. If you wish to extend your studies, please fill in the
application for extension
doc, 45 kb
· de
and upload it in the
Study Portal Friedolin 2.0
External link
(Student Service >> Locking >>
Submit documents to remove the lock
), see
wiki guide
External link

Participants of the DSH course
Re-registration for a second DSH course semester
Upload your
positive certificate of course participation (Leistungsnachweis)
issued at the end of the first semesterin the
Study Portal Friedolin 2.0
External link
(Student Service >> Locking >>
Submit documents to remove the lock
).
In the
comment
, mention that you wish to take part in a second course semester.
Pay the semester fee and the course fee by 15 February/15 August.
Take part in the entrance test (placement in course 1 is required).
See also the
wiki guide
External link
.
Registration for the DSH exam
Upload your
positive certificate of course participation (Leistungsnachweis)
issued at the end of the semester in the
Study Portal Friedolin 2.0
External link
(Student Service >> Applications >>
Further Applications
>> DSH exam registration).
In the
comment
, mention that you wish to take part in the DSH exam.
Pay the examination fee and take part in the exam.
Pay the semester fee by 15 February/15 August and
apply for enrolment to the regular study programme after admission.
See also the
wiki guide
External link
.
Participants of the Studienkolleg
You may
re-register for the second semester
by uploading the participation certificate of Internationales Studienzentrum Jena in the
Study Portal Friedolin 2.0
External link
(Student Service >> Applications >>
Locking
>> Submit documents to remove the lock).
Pay the semester fee by 15 February/15 August.
See also the
wiki guide
External link
.
